name: Jessop Rent Cap

source_sentences: Yearly rent increases for sitting tenants are capped at 1 percent.
A tenancy passes, at the capped rent, to any person the tenant names in writing as successor, who takes over the tenancy on the same terms.

context: In Jessop, outgoing tenants commonly receive a payment from the person they name.
Market rents rise about 6 percent a year, and the Rent Board enforces the cap.
